reason: The text helper itself: it picks the font file of a weight (the one place a family is set)
The hidden bold copy that reserves a text's widest width, so selecting never moves the row: not a look
The hidden field that takes the typing of a code drawn in cells: invisible by function, not a design opacity
The hidden field that takes the typing of the delivery time drawn in the dial: invisible by function, not a design opacity
The largest side, in pixels, of a photo picked for a message (the image picker's upload limit): not a look

The loading page draws the native launch splash's square logo at the size the native splash draws it, 120 x 120 (the storyboard's image view, the Android canvases' 120 dp logo): a build asset's geometry, not a design value (docs/SPLASH.md)
A sheet's list never covers the whole screen: it scrolls past 60 % of the window height
